concepts.title: Statistics vs Probability — Foundations
concepts.notes: Created 2026-06-24. Covers: stats vs probability (two directions), what a distribution is, E[X] from dice analogy, variance, PMF vs PDF, Bernoulli, distribution roadmap for all 6 tasks, Normal and Gamma intros. Prerequisite for task1-bernoulli and all other task decks.

concepts.title: Bernoulli trial & expectation
concepts.notes: 2026-08-22 refreshed for parameter set 99d9e51e: p = 0.65 (was 0.58), E[X] = 0.65, Var = 0.2275, sd = 0.47697. Pedagogy unchanged (label gun, why 'random', E[X] seesaw) since it was confirmed to work. Superseded deck kept for comparison.

concepts.title: Important probability distributions (Unit 3 survey)
concepts.notes: Deck created 2026-07-03 (19 slides incl. 3 sub-chapters) after Elena said she was struggling with chapter 3. Organizing frame: every distribution answers one everyday question. Covers: binomial (+ why n-choose-k, sub), negative binomial (flip the question), normal via Galton board + CLT (+ Irwin-Hall sum-of-5-uniforms sub), 68/95/99.7 sigma ruler with the book's ±1σ-excludes-32% gotcha, Poisson (+ binomial-limit sub), Gamma-Poisson overdispersion → NB (two doors into one distribution), exponential derived from P(0 events)=e^-λt, Weibull three k regimes, transformation theorem with rubber-sheet/area-preservation intuition, family-tree map, exam-task mapping, traps, quiz. All curves computed numerically.

concepts.title: Survival function → PDF
concepts.notes: 2026-08-22 REWRITTEN: branch changed xi4 3 -> 1, so F̄(y) = (2/3)e^(-8y²) + (1/3)e^(-5y⁸) — a mixture of Weibull shape 2 (Rayleigh) and shape 8, hence BIMODAL (peaks ~15.0 and ~47.9 min). Generator gave 0.66+0.33 = 0.99; renormalised to exactly 2/3 and 1/3 and documented. E[Y] = 27.94 min, Var = 0.068605 h², Q1/med/Q3 = 14.54/24.90/42.79 min, P(2<Y<4) = 8.44e-15. Key trick taught: E[Y] = ∫F̄ for Y ≥ 0.

concepts.title: Sum of exponentials & MLE
concepts.notes: 2026-08-22 REWRITTEN: branch changed xi9 2 -> 0, so S ~ Exponential(θ) and T = S1+S2 ~ Gamma(2,θ) by convolution. The 120-vs-720 typo warning NO LONGER APPLIES (it was specific to the xi9=2 line) and was dropped. Sample (33,29,6,37,1), n=5, θ̂ = T̄/2 = 10.6 TB, E[T] = 21.2 TB. se 3.352, so the 95% interval [4.03, 17.17] is very wide at n=5.

concepts.title: Testing mean / variance claims
concepts.notes: 2026-08-22 CONCLUSION FLIPPED. New data: μ0 = 842, σ0 = 55.3, n = 10, x̄ = 852.2, z = 0.5833, p = 0.2799 -> FAIL TO REJECT (the old deck concluded reject and is wrong for this data). z-vs-t still open: t = 0.2567 on 9 df, p = 0.4016, same conclusion. Power at the observed effect is only 14.4%; the minimum detectable difference at 80% power is 43.5 g vs an observed 10.2 g. Red flag: s = 125.65 vs σ0 = 55.3 is a variance ratio of 5.16.

concepts.title: OLS & ridge regression
concepts.notes: 2026-08-22 refreshed: new 22-point dataset, degree 10. Headline lesson is CONDITIONING — raw Vandermonde cond 1.02e13, after rescaling x to [-1,1] 3.74e3. Solve by SVD, never by inverting X'X. λ* = 4.5e-4 by leave-one-out CV; coefficient norm 6.63 -> 1.007 (-84.8%). Quality answer: least squares is dominated by |y| ~ 6e13 at the edges, so for |x| <= 7 both fits are worthless (fitted intercept 1.90e11 OLS vs observed y(0) = -0.98).

concepts.title: Gamma conjugate posterior
concepts.notes: 2026-08-22 refreshed + rate-vs-scale addressed head-on. Hogg writes β as a SCALE, so prior Gamma(23,63) has rate 1/63. Posterior Gamma(53, rate 954.8159); Bayes estimate (squared-error) = 0.0555081; mode = 0.0544608. Alternative reading of ξ18 as a rate gives 0.0520731 / 0.0510906, a 6.19% difference. Strong prior-influence illustration: the MLE α/x̄ = 0.03142 lies OUTSIDE the 95% credible interval [0.0416, 0.0714].
